headline: Techera wins Rs 8.63 Cr GSE order from private space firm
summary: Techera Engineering secures Rs 8.63 crore work order for ground support equipment structures. Order value is ~17% of FY26 revenue. Backlog conversion and margin stability are key watchpoints.

headline: KDDL Q2FY27: Revenue up 31.6%, Eigen grows 50%
summary: KDDL Ltd reported a 31.6% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹698.7 crore in Q2FY27. The precision engineering division, Eigen, saw 50% growth, driving capacity expansion plans.

headline: Palm Jewels open offer at ₹24.14 per share
summary: Acquirers launch mandatory open offer for 26% equity in Palm Jewels at ₹24.14 per share, following a 43.36% stake purchase from existing promoters.

headline: Shukra Medtech to raise ₹648 crore via preferential issue
summary: Shukra Medtech plans a preferential issue of 6 crore shares at ₹108 to promoter Parshva Texchem. Board meeting scheduled for Dec 2, 2026.

headline: Cipla secures FDA approval for generic Flovent HFA
summary: Cipla and Teva receive FDA approval for the first generic Flovent HFA in 110 mcg and 220 mcg strengths. The product targets a $350 million US market.

headline: Radico Khaitan launches Rampur Jugalbandi #7 and #8
summary: Radico Khaitan launches the final two expressions of its Rampur Jugalbandi series in India. The limited edition, priced at ₹50,000, marks a strategic push into luxury spirits.

headline: Govt may ease sugar imports to stabilise prices
summary: The government may ease sugar import restrictions, with limited shipments potentially prompting around 2 MT of imports to stabilise domestic prices.

headline: Carmakers hike vehicle prices to offset input costs
summary: Tata Motors, Hyundai, and Audi are raising vehicle prices to counter rising input costs, while Maruti has already implemented its fourth price hike this year.

headline: Egg prices fall 10-20% on bird flu, weak demand
summary: Egg prices have dropped 10-20% as bird flu disrupts Tamil Nadu exports, flooding the domestic market with surplus supply amid weak seasonal demand.

headline: Bulk diesel sales plunge 33% as buyers shift to retail pumps
summary: Bulk diesel sales have fallen 33% as commercial and industrial buyers move to retail fuel pumps, where diesel is cheaper by ₹38 per litre amid disruptions from the Iran war.

headline: Adani Enterprises signs $1B copper anode supply deal
summary: Adani Enterprises has signed a $1 billion deal with Attero for the monthly supply of 2,000 metric tonne of copper anode over three years for its Kutch smelter in Gujarat.

headline: Jefferies maintains Buy on Welspun Corp, target ₹3,250
summary: Jefferies reiterates Buy on Welspun Corp with a target price of ₹3,250, citing a US$5.2bn order book, 25% EBITDA CAGR target through FY30, and a US$125mn Jordan expansion.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.1898%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield declined to 7.1898% from the previous close of 7.1983%, reflecting a marginal easing in yields.

headline: Indian rupee opens at 84.74 vs dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 92.74 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 92.91, reflecting a marginal strengthening in the domestic currency.

headline: Goldman Sachs maintains Buy on PTC Industries
summary: Goldman Sachs maintains Buy on PTC Industries with a target price of ₹26,655, citing a 400-tonne domestic defence titanium order that accounts for 53% of estimated FY28 VAR production.

headline: APL Apollo Tubes downgraded to Sell by ICICI, Elara
summary: ICICI Securities and Elara Capital downgrade APL Apollo Tubes to Sell. Target prices cut to ₹1,345 and ₹1,413 respectively due to debt-funded Tata Steel acquisition.

headline: Goldman Sachs keeps buy on JSW Steel, target ₹1,545
summary: Goldman Sachs maintains a positive view on JSW Steel with a target price of ₹1,545, forecasting 38% EBITDA growth in FY27 and capacity expansion to 53.8mtpa by FY31.

headline: Shreeji promoter buys 25k shares
summary: Chandrika Rajnikant Shah purchased 25,669 shares of Shreeji Translogistics on Nov 23. Her holding rises to 0.45% after correcting prior reporting errors.

headline: Piramal Pharma shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~9,93,06,749 Piramal Pharma shares changing hands on BSE at ₹225.5, with a combined value of ₹2,239.37 crore, at open.

headline: G Jerambhai acquires AI Champdany stake below offer price
summary: G Jerambhai Exports acquired 40.53 lakh AI Champdany shares at ₹27.14, below the ₹29.50 open offer price, avoiding a revision requirement.

headline: Exhicon elevates Simon Dennis to CEO of Luxury Sports
summary: Exhicon Events Media Solutions appoints Simon Dennis as CEO - Luxury Sports. The move leverages his five-year tenure at Pinewoods Golf Club to expand the group's sports hospitality and MICE portfolio.

headline: HMA Agro to explore poultry diversification
summary: HMA Agro Industries will participate in Poultry India 2026 Expo to explore opportunities in the chicken and poultry segment via its subsidiary.

headline: BHEL ED K G Vijayalakshmi superannuates
summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited announced the superannuation of Executive Director (Receivable Management) K G Vijayalakshmi on November 24, 2026.

headline: Lancor promoter stake rises to 23.22% via warrant conversion
summary: Shymala Shekar acquired 29.33 lakh shares in Lancor Holdings through warrant conversion, raising her holding to 23.22%. The move follows a preferential allotment.

headline: Altius InvIT declares ₹4.04 per unit distribution
summary: Altius Telecom Infrastructure Trust declared a total distribution of ₹4.0362 per unit. The record date is November 30, 2026, with payment due by December 7, 2026.

headline: HDFC MF raises stake in Zensar Technologies to 9.04%
summary: HDFC Mutual Fund increased its holding in Zensar Technologies by 2.04% via open market purchases, bringing total stake to 9.04% as of November 19, 2026.

headline: SBI MF cuts Brigade Hotel stake to 3.01%
summary: SBI Mutual Fund reduced its holding in Brigade Hotel Ventures to 3.01% after selling 2.82 lakh shares on November 20, 2026.

headline: Bandhan MF crosses 5% stake in Fedbank Financial
summary: Bandhan Mutual Fund and Vedartha India Opportunities Fund increased their combined holding in Fedbank Financial Services to 5.0216% after acquiring 0.048% shares on open market.

headline: Duncan Engineering sees DGM resignation
summary: Duncan Engineering Ltd announced the resignation of Yuvraj Prabhakar Narsule, Deputy General Manager and Head of Application Engineering, effective November 23, 2026.

headline: Heritage Foods RTA KFin shifts office Dec 1
summary: Heritage Foods Ltd announced that its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, will shift its corporate office to a new Hyderabad address effective December 1, 2026.

headline: Bandhan MF raises stake in Rashi Peripherals to 9.16%
summary: Bandhan Mutual Fund increased its holding in Rashi Peripherals to 9.1624% after acquiring 14.55 lakh shares. The move follows a 2.19% rise in ownership via open market purchases.

headline: Canara HSBC Life CFO Tarun Rustagi resigns
summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance CFO Tarun Rustagi resigned effective November 24, 2026, to pursue external growth opportunities after a seven-year tenure.

headline: Angel One CBO Arief Mohamad resigns
summary: Angel One Limited announced the resignation of Chief Business Officer Arief Mohamad. His cessation is effective December 31, 2026.

headline: Sun Pharma shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~1,91,443 Sun Pharma shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,879.70, with a combined value of ₹35.99 crore.

headline: Jupiter Wagons shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,777,896 Jupiter Wagons shares changing hands on NSE at ₹222.46, with a combined value of ₹39.55 crore.

headline: Siemens Q2FY27: Orders jump 38%, revenue up 17%
summary: Siemens Limited reported a 37.8% surge in new orders and 17% revenue growth for Q2FY27, driven by strong demand in Digital Industries and Mobility.

headline: Damodar Industries promoter Arun Biyani transfers 67,000 shares
summary: Arun Kumar Biyani, a promoter of Damodar Industries, disclosed an inter-se transfer of 67,000 equity shares on November 20, 2026. His holding remains at 35.127% of voting capital.

headline: Rajratan Global Wire to set up Netherlands subsidiary
summary: Rajratan Global Wire Ltd board approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the Netherlands. The entity, Rajratan Wire Europe, will be capitalized with €50,000.

headline: Promoter Arun Agarwal boosts stake in Associated Ceramics to 13.07%
summary: Arun Agarwal acquired 2,00,000 shares of Associated Ceramics Ltd from Amar Jyoti Udyog Ltd on November 23, 2026, raising his holding to 13.07%.

headline: Zim Labs board approves upside sharing pact
summary: Zim Laboratories board approved an upside sharing agreement between promoter and third party, subject to public shareholder approval via postal ballot.

headline: Anondita Medicare adds 4 lines, capacity hits 1.114B pieces
summary: Anondita Medicare has added four new manufacturing lines for male latex condoms, boosting annual capacity to 1.114 billion pieces with an investment of ₹75 crore.

headline: Samvardhana Motherson shares flag large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,154,589 Samvardhana Motherson International shares changing hands on NSE at ₹162.55, with a combined value of ₹35.02 crore.

headline: Gopal Snacks shifts to mass-premium brand strategy
summary: Gopal Snacks announces strategic pivot to mass-premium segment with new categories and packaging renovation, aiming for margin expansion.

headline: Rishi Laser Q2FY27: Revenue up 27%, PAT falls
summary: Rishi Laser reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹54.23 crore, up 26.58% YoY. However, net profit declined 45.87% to ₹1.14 crore due to higher depreciation and finance costs from the Malur facility ramp-up.

headline: Virtuoso Optoelectronics to meet ICICI PMS on Dec 8
summary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics Limited will hold a virtual one-on-one meeting with ICICI PMS on December 8, 2026, at 4:00 pm IST. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Government launches ₹50,000 crore power distribution scheme
summary: The government has announced a new ₹50,000 crore scheme for power distribution companies, with Adani Power among the entities linked to the development.

headline: SJ Corp promoter sells 2 lakh shares
summary: Ushaben Savjibhai Patel, a promoter of SJ Corporation Ltd, sold 200,000 equity shares (0.46%) on the open market on November 23, 2026.

headline: JHS Svendgaard Labs acquires 4.35 lakh shares in Retail Ventures
summary: JHS Svendgaard Laboratories acquired 4,35,000 equity shares of JHS Svendgaard Retail Ventures via warrant conversion, raising its stake to 4.91%.

headline: IVP Q2FY27 Results: Revenue up 17%, PAT rises 16%
summary: IVP Limited reported a 17% YoY increase in revenue to ₹172 crore for Q2FY27. Net profit grew 16% YoY to ₹5 crore, while EBITDA margins contracted sequentially.

headline: Dhruv Consultancy promoter group buys 1,011 shares
summary: Dhruv Consultancy Services promoter group acquired 1,011 equity shares via open market on November 23, 2026. Post-acquisition holding stands at 2,513 shares.

headline: L&T secures significant contract worth ₹10B–₹25B
summary: Larsen & Toubro has secured a significant contract valued between ₹10 billion and ₹25 billion, marking a notable order win for the engineering and construction conglomerate.

headline: Sanghvi Movers to meet Aequitas Investments on Nov 30
summary: Sanghvi Movers Limited will hold a virtual one-on-one meeting with Aequitas Investments on November 30, 2026. The discussion will focus on general business outlook using public domain information.

headline: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech IPO Day 1
summary: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO opens on Day 1 with overall subscription at 0.15x. QIB category leads at 4.27x; Retail at 0.08x. Price band ₹130–₹142.

headline: Phoenix Mills block trade of ₹68.79 crore on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 2,99,999 shares of Phoenix Mills was executed on BSE at ₹2,293.00 per share, totalling ₹68.79 crore.

headline: Esaar promoter Prabhat Capital raises stake to 38.55%
summary: Prabhat Capital Investments acquired 17.97 lakh equity shares of Esaar (India) Ltd in open market, increasing its promoter holding from 36.31% to 38.55%.

headline: Balu Forge promoter buys 60,000 shares
summary: Jaspalsingh Prehladsingh Chandock acquired 60,000 equity shares of Balu Forge Industries via open market on Nov 23, 2026. His stake rose to 49.8542%.

headline: Manav Poddar acquires 3.60% in Harmony Capital
summary: Manav Poddar acquired 8.89 lakh shares of Harmony Capital Services via preferential allotment, raising his stake to 3.60% post-issue.

headline: CFF Fluid Control promoter acquires 13.26% stake via gift
summary: Gautam Makker, promoter of CFF Fluid Control, will acquire 13.26% equity shares from family members through an off-market gift transfer, increasing his holding to 34.03%.

headline: Aarti Industries eyes agri and pharma growth
summary: Aarti Industries states that the launch of chlorotoluene and an increase in its production will create new opportunities in the agriculture and pharmaceutical sectors.

headline: Aurobindo Pharma RTA address change
summary: Aurobindo Pharma notified exchanges of a change in the corporate office address of its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, effective December 1, 2026.

headline: K.V. Toys H1FY27 Results: Income up 29%
summary: K.V. Toys India reported 29% YoY income growth and 19% net profit rise in H1FY27. Management highlights backward integration and proposed Play Panda investment.
